GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, off rail ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, took over 100m and drew clear late # all honours

Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field rails 9 Lengths 1000m, rider got him moving from the 600m and he soon let down, sustained run Wide once balanced-up and when he drove to lead last 150m he dashed away for soft win from the back # sustained run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , got back 2nd last 9 Lengths 1000m, never came on from turn # always out back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced keenly 5th on rail (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & held up Two Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along @ 250m & held ground hands & heels in last 200m. # Good 1st-up run.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running during the early part of the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length well back Settled Down 2nd last fence 8 Lengths 1400m 2nd last 10 Lengths 1000m 2nd last 8 Lengths 600m Hooked Out 7th 5 Lengths home turn 4th widest runner Straight hit lead 200m run down final 100m # good run/ready
Jumped Ok sat back 9l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
Jumped Ok sat 7l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover from the 1300m. A post-race veterinary  examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, pushed along took over turn, Straightened Up half clear and kept going strong to the line increasing margin # soft win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was deemed suitable to start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped. A short distance after the start was bumped on the hindquarters.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1len Settled Down 2nd last 8len 600m 3rd last made good ground final 200m # made late ground

jumped ok from low draw. Settled Down Inside 9th, 9 Lengths @ 1100m. Hooked Out Wide and Ridden Along Took off to 600m. 3rd into Straight , Kept Finding line . Winner Led All The Way # early move/1st led
